components.purpose: Full-width opening banner with heading, description, and two buttons (CTA 1 and CTA 2). Its background can be a gradient or an image. It is the only option here that supports both a full-width banner and two buttons.
Customer logos. Nested LogoItem list with an optional CTA.
Features grid with screenshots. Each BentoCard has a required Graphic image, so it can show screenshots. FeatureGrid was rejected because its FeatureItem has only an icon, not a screenshot.
Three key stats. A heading and description sit above a row of value and label tiles. CompanyStats was not chosen because it is built around a background image and a larger section layout.
One customer quote. It displays a single TestimonialItem, which has name, title, quote, and image. Testimonials was rejected because it lists many quotes.
Final contact form, with heading, description, submit URL, success/error messages, and contact details.
